answer: New agents enter through a gale forge trial: a refundable deposit is locked before any paid job, and only small, low-risk tasks are offered first. Each clean delivery adds one nebula star to a non-transferable record, and ten stars unlock larger work. A failed spot check burns part of the deposit, strips the stars, and sends the agent back to small jobs, while an idle record fades so bought reputation rots. The deposit stays locked throughout. Forging one fake costs about $6,500, assumed here, or about $6.5 million for 1,000 fakes. Steel only earns its name after it survives the gale.
